Baldwins Get Hung Jury, DA Vows New Trial

From steve@kubby.org (Steve Kubby)

(AUBURN, CA.) The jury in the Baldwin ended up hung in a 6-6 split on Michael Baldwin and voted 7-5 to acquit Georgia Baldwin. Normally such an even split in a hung jury would not be challenged, but the Placer County D.A.’s office has already announced their intention to re-try the Baldwins.

Steve Kubby, who is scheduled to appear on similar charges in the same court says, "Our hearts go out to Dr. Baldwin and his wife who have suffered so terribly by this entire ordeal and must now go through this painful experience again. Naturally, we are disappointing with the outcome of what should have been an automatic acquittal, but it only strengthens our resolve to win a decisive victory for ourselves and for seriously ill patients everywhere."

See
Judge Rules That Prop 215 Protects Against Cultivation Charge;
Major Implications For Kubby and Other Cases. Possible "Sales" Charge Remains.
and links

(Marijuananews note: They are even less likely to get a conviction on a second round.

Nonetheless, by abusing prosecutorial power, a vindictive DA can impose ruinous de facto fines in the form of attorneys’ fees on innocent people.

Moreover, in the case of medical marijuana patients, they can impose a form of cruel and unusual punishment by subjecting them to the stress inherent in such a prosecution which can very adversely affect their health.

Often people in this situation are forced to enter into a plea bargain even though they could never be convicted.

This is an absurd waste of the county’s resources, and a terrible injustice, so the public should be doubly outraged.)
